summary: 45-year-old Denver man reported as a possible lost hiker on Bright Trail near Allenspark at 9:30 p.m.; an immediate evening search of nearby trails and roads found nothing; the search resumed May 5 at 7:45 a.m. and the hiker was found on the trail, uninjured and needing no medical assistance.
notes: Found May 5; BW police-blotter item "Hiker found after two-day search"; run 712.
